_comment: Pinned on purpose: a system driver (xess-xmx-linux) and ClawDeck's own OptiScaler + OptiPatcher are installed only at a tested version (OptiScaler with its sha256); 'pending-verification' asks before installing the latest. tools/upstream_watch.py reports newer ones.

xess_xmx_linux.note: 20261115: low latency on the FSR routes lets a queue of more than 6 ms on the GPU decide the wait (upstream: CONTROL Resonant 3x from 52.6 to 48.4 ms), a game's own XeSS-FG 30 % lower latency (Cyberpunk 2077 3x: 45.1 to 31.7 ms), stock mode (unpatched Mesa + layer) now also the default on Xe2 (Claw 8 AI+), from the layer's GPU list; VK_EXT_descriptor_heap joins VKD3D_DISABLE_EXTENSIONS in the session file (ClawDeck carries the session file's values); new options XESS=auto, XESS_LL, XESS_LOG=2 (XESS=latest unchanged); the session file, hook mark, shim path, xellSleep stats line and igd_faux path ClawDeck reads are unchanged. 20261113: one low-latency path for XeSS frame generation, the FSR routes and OFLOW_FG (the shim answers swap-chain queries made after Present; upstream reports CONTROL Resonant 3x on an Arc B390 from 35.5 to about 23 ms), experimental Vulkan XeSS on XMX for Xe-HPG and Xe2 through the patched driver (Xe3 stays on the layer), the session check no longer falls back to the unpatched driver when the patched one fails, the archive is single-nested again; the session file, hook mark and shim path ClawDeck reads are unchanged. 20261111: Mesa 26.3.0 final; on Xe3 (Claw 8 EX / Panther Lake) install.sh now defaults to stock mode: the package's unpatched Mesa 26.3 plus the Vulkan layer VK_LAYER_XESS_xmx (its session file adds MESA, VK_ADD_LAYER_PATH, VK_LOADER_LAYERS_ENABLE, XMX_LAYER_HELPER, XMX_IGC_DIR, which ClawDeck carries per game like the others and sets before the container, as upstream's xmx-stock.sh does; the layer writes the same anv_canary); Xe2 (Claw 8 AI+) and older stay on the patched driver. XESS=latest also serves D3D11 and Vulkan games. 20261107: hardening of the driver, shim and hook, the other missing kernels compiled in the background on a cache miss, Mesa 26.3 patch 0006 (a Cyberpunk 2077 crash), the session check run from ~/.config/xess-xmx (stock drivers when the package folder is gone), any case of the prefix driver store; the session file, hook mark and shim path ClawDeck reads are unchanged. Also an experimental Vulkan layer for the stock driver (xmx-stock.sh), not used by ClawDeck yet. 20261104: low latency with XeSS frame generation on by default (IGDEXT_XELL_CAP), FSR 3.1+ games on XeSS (FSR=xess), XESS_FG up to 8x

decky_framegen.note: v0.17 (OptiScaler 0.9.4, FSR 4 variants) installed and opened on the Claw 8 EX 2026-11-04. OptiScaler per game (Bazzite ships it in the Portal); ClawDeck installs it only where it is missing, and passes Intel presets to it through its environment variables

reframework.note: Capcom RE Engine games: dinput8.dll (23252480 bytes, REFramework 0.1.0.69) next to the game's exe. onehoon's fork (the fork's author), release 15 built 2026-10-22, whose notes say to use it with OptiScaler in Capcom games: a working Windows Onimusha install runs exactly this file, and it booted and played with optiscaler_v10 on a Claw 8 EX on Bazzite (2026-11-04). Replaces praydog's nightly 01433: ClawDeck installs REFramework only together with the Capcom OptiScaler setup, and the fork is the build that setup was tested with. Release 18 (2026-11-05) since 2026-11-09: three upstream syncs over release 15 (Lua JSON and LooseFileLoader fixes, HookManager error paths and thread safety, ARM64EC hooks skipped), dinput8.dll 23262720 bytes; release 15's dll stays recognised (previous_dll_sha256) so Remove still takes it out. Release 19 (2026-11-13) since 2026-11-14: one upstream sync over release 18 (pending script state deletions cleared on reset), dinput8.dll 23262208 bytes, REFramework 0.1.0.73; releases 18 and 15 stay recognised.

optiscaler.note: ClawDeck's own OptiScaler (optiscaler.py). 0.9.5 (2026-11-16) since 2026-11-17: the last packed release of the 0.9 branch (upstream: maintenance mode, v10 is where work goes); FFX 2.4 SDK (FSR 4.1.2, FSR-FG 4.0.2), XeSS 3.0.2 SDK, fakenvapi 1.4.1 and nukem 0.130 bundled. Same flat layout as 0.9.4 plus amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll and amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_vk.dll; every OptiScaler.ini key ClawDeck writes is still there, [FSR] Fsr4ForceEnableInt8 is now 0-3 instead of true/false (ClawDeck doesn't write it: the retired fsr4 preset becomes fsr4_xmx), [FSRFG] DisableFlipMetering is new. sha256 is GitHub's asset digest, checked against the download. fsr4_xmx_index: where FSR 4.1.2X and its Lite sit in OptiScaler's FFX upscaler list with nitec's files ([FSR] UpscalerIndex; 0.9.5 selects by position only), read from OptiScaler's log in Stellar Blade on a Claw 8 EX AI+ 2026-11-17: [0] 4.1.1 * (FFX 2.4's own, new in 0.9.5), [1-6] 4.0.2X (Skip, QSkip, Hybrid, Hybrid Skip, Hybrid QSkip), [7] 4.1.2X, [8-9] its Skip / QSkip, [10] 4.1.2X Lite, [11] Lite Skip; one later than 0.9.4's 6 / 9, so 0.9.4's 6 picked 4.0.2X Hybrid QSkip. 0.9.4 before it: the same release and OptiPatcher build Decky Framegen v0.17 pins. previous: the earlier pins a game set up with an older ClawDeck may still have; changing a setting keeps that version (main._opti_entry), only Per-game's Update OptiScaler moves the game to this one.

optiscaler_v10.note: Capcom RE Engine games only (optiscaler.py layout 'subfolder'): OptiScaler.dll as the proxy and OptiScaler.ini next to the exe, everything else in OptiScaler\ (OptiDllPath), OptiPatcher in OptiScaler\plugins. a working Windows Onimusha install uses 0.9.5-pre4, which isn't published on GitHub; this public v10 nightly ran Onimusha with onehoon's REFramework on a Claw 8 EX on Bazzite (2026-11-04). Every other game stays on 'optiscaler' (0.9.4). fakenvapi v1.4.1 (FakeMichau) goes in OptiScaler\ with the tested fakenvapi.ini, as in the tested folder: its fakenvapi.dll (415232 bytes) is byte-identical to the one OptiScaler 0.9.4 ships. OptiScaler v10 has fakenvapi built in ([fakenvapi] UseFakenvapi, set to true) and doesn't load the file; it is there to match the setup tested on the Claw.

fsr4_xmx.note: nitec's FSR 4.1.2 build for the XMX cores (OptiScaler community), shared with ClawDeck with nitec's OK (maintainer, 2026-11-05), the same files the tested setup installs on Intel (its Archives/Custom/FSR4_XMX). Hosted on ClawDeck's fsr4-xmx-files branch, pinned by commit (not on the Releases page); downloaded into ~/fsr4-xmx when missing, each sha256 checked (the maintainer's working copy on the Claw 8 EX, 2026-11-04).
